Built In-House

Dataset & Pipeline Automation

Custom tools built to eliminate manual data work and speed up the model training loop.

01
Dataset De-duplication — removes duplicate and visually similar images using perceptual hashing
02
Auto-Sort via Clustering — sorts raw images using KNN and clustering to organize datasets automatically
03
Web Scraping & Sort — collects images from the web and auto-sorts by category for dataset building
04
Classification-based Sorter — uses trained classification models to sort unlabeled data into class folders
05
Video Auto-Collector — extracts and crops moving objects from CCTV video via OpenCV line-crossing detection
06
Auto Annotator — generates YOLO annotations using pre-trained detection and segmentation models
07
Data Management CLI — rename/merge labels, mask labels, export to YOLO, remove corrupt/empty annotations
08
Model-based Cropper — crops object instances from images using detection models for classification datasets
09
Inference Benchmark Tool — compares multiple model versions across detection, classification, segmentation with Excel reports

Deployment Strategy & Techniques

Real-world experience running multi-camera CV systems on edge hardware — from RTSP ingestion to service orchestration and live model updates.

📡

Multi-Camera RTSP Handling

Manages multiple CCTV streams simultaneously with buffer management for RTSP, handling camera downtime and reconnects without system interruption.

⚙️

Microservices Architecture

Multiple independent services handle separate pipeline stages — ingestion, inference, event generation, storage — enabling parallel processing across cameras.

🐇

RabbitMQ Event Handling

Uses RabbitMQ for async event messaging between services. Redis used for temporary frame storage, decoupling inference from downstream processing.

🧩

Multi-Model Batching

Runs multiple model formats concurrently with batching strategies across camera feeds. Supports TensorRT, ONNX, NCNN, and OpenVINO engines simultaneously.

🔧

Model Updates & Fine-Tuning Config

Understands live model swap strategies on edge without downtime. Fine-tunes inference configurations — thresholds, NMS, tracking params — for real-time accuracy.

📋

Configuration Management

Centralized config files define service requirements, camera settings, model paths, and pipeline parameters — making deployments reproducible and auditable.

🤝

Cross-Team Collaboration

Works with development, deployment, and operations teams to streamline model-to-production workflow — bridging ML training and system engineering.

🖥️

Centralized System Dashboard

Built a unified view for monitoring all services, cameras, and model inference status across the entire deployment from one place.

🔄

Service Lifecycle Management

Handles starting, stopping, and restarting individual services on edge devices. Troubleshoots camera and inference failures with minimal manual intervention.

🐳

Docker & Ansible Automation

Uses Docker for containerized deployment and Ansible for automated provisioning and configuration across 130+ edge devices — reducing manual setup to zero.
